hard_negatives: the set includes hard negatives whose machine labels are already correct, with machine tree fidelity passed and core status valid_for_core_stats; they serve as 'machine output is correct' controls
integrity: all 411 formula_id unique; no formula_id collision with the Silver 792 records
cross_set_note: 3 generic formula trees (A x=b, x=A^{-1}b, y=A x+v) also occur in the Silver 792 records, from different books/pages and independent typesetting; not duplicates of the same record. For strict leakage isolation, group by tree.
sampling_note: Gold is a directed human-review product; 411 is not a denominator for overall accuracy. Source PDFs and page images are not distributed.
